## KnowVault — Cost & Quality
Per-answer usage from the ledger (tokens, cost, latency), plus service health. Data source: Application Insights.

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Usage: tenant"
| parse message with * "tenant " tenant " prompt " prompt:long " + completion " completion:long " tokens = $" cost:real " in " durationMs:real "ms"
| summarize Answers = count(), ['Total cost (USD)'] = round(sum(cost), 4), ['Avg cost / answer'] = round(avg(cost), 6), ['Prompt tokens'] = sum(prompt), ['Completion tokens'] = sum(completion), ['Latency p95 (ms)'] = round(percentile(durationMs, 95), 0)
content.title: Totals for the selected period

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Usage: tenant"
| parse message with * "tenant " tenant " prompt " prompt:long " + completion " completion:long " tokens = $" cost:real " in " durationMs:real "ms"
| summarize ['Cost (USD)'] = sum(cost) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Answer cost over time (USD)

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Usage: tenant"
| parse message with * "tenant " tenant " prompt " prompt:long " + completion " completion:long " tokens = $" cost:real " in " durationMs:real "ms"
| summarize Tokens = sum(prompt + completion) by tenant, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Tokens by tenant

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Usage: tenant"
| parse message with * "tenant " tenant " prompt " prompt:long " + completion " completion:long " tokens = $" cost:real " in " durationMs:real "ms"
| summarize ['p50 (ms)'] = percentile(durationMs, 50), ['p95 (ms)'] = percentile(durationMs, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Answer latency p50 / p95 (plan alert threshold: 8000ms p95)

content.query:
requests
| summarize Requests = count(), Failed = countif(success == false) by cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp, 1h)
| render timechart
content.title: Requests by service (with failures)

content.query:
traces
| where message startswith "Usage: tenant"
| parse message with * "tenant " tenant " prompt " prompt:long " + completion " completion:long " tokens = $" cost:real " in " durationMs:real "ms"
| project timestamp, tenant, prompt, completion, ['cost (USD)'] = cost, ['duration (ms)'] = durationMs
| top 50 by timestamp desc
content.title: Recent answers (usage ledger)
